text:
```artifact
Feature: Lab Management System

  Scenario: Lab In-charge views and updates open lab-requests
    Given the lab-in-charge is logged in
    And there are open lab-requests
    When the lab-in-charge views the open lab-requests
    Then the lab-in-charge should see the open lab-requests
    And the lab-in-charge should have the option to update the status

  Scenario: Lab In-charge updates the status of lab-requests
    Given the lab-in-charge is logged in
    And there are open lab-requests
    When the lab-in-charge updates the status of a lab-request to "Actual Sample Collection"
    And the lab-in-charge updates the status of another lab-request to "Lab Tests"
    Then the status of the lab-request should be updated to "Actual Sample Collection"
    And the status of the other lab-request should be updated to "Lab Tests"

  Scenario: Lab submits reports to Patient offline
    Given the lab-in-charge is logged in
    And there are completed lab-requests
    When the lab-in-charge submits a report for a completed lab-request
    Then the report should be submitted to the Patient offline

  Scenario: Patient views the Prescription and prints the invoice
    Given the patient is logged in
    And there is a Prescription for the patient
    When the patient views the Prescription
    Then the patient should see the Prescription
    And the patient should have the option to print the invoice

  Scenario: Admin prints and emails the Prescription and Invoice
    Given the admin is logged in
    And there is a Prescription and Invoice for a patient
    When the admin prints and emails the Prescription and Invoice
    Then the Prescription and Invoice should be printed and emailed to the patient

  Scenario: Quarterly archiving of Patient Profiles and Consultation Requests
    Given the system is running for more than 3 years
    And there are Patient Profiles that have not raised any Consultation Request for the last 3 years
    And there are Consultation Requests that are more than 3 years old
    When the system runs the quarterly archiving process
    Then the Patient Profiles that have not raised any Consultation Request for the last 3 years should be archived
    And the Consultation Requests that are more than 3 years old should be archived
```
